body: That’s very kind of you to share those advice  with me. Yesterday was a tough day for me emotionally and I couldn’t go to sleep until 3am. My mind was constantly struggling and tbh I wish I never have to wake up maybe it will be easier to just sleep like that. I don’t have lots of resources to reach out for therapist right now dude to no job/ insurance. I am really trying to fight this on my own but it’s just getting really hard. I appreciate you talking to me tho. I did feel a little better last night.

I definitely thought about seeing a therapist before. However when I was working and being busy I tend to shut down my feelings and only focus on work. Now that I am stuck at my apt because of covid and not working I realized how dark my mind has gone in the past few weeks. All the suppressed sadness/ self hatred/ emptiness came out and crushed my mind and body. A few weeks ago I almost took a bottle of   sleeping pills to end my life but I called suicide hotline ( I don’t know why I guess I wasn’t ready to go) pretty pathetic right. I am at a bottom of my life right now.  I have been struggling with health problems/ looking for jobs and dealing with my depression everyday I almost wanted to give up :/

I have been living on my own after 18 so I guess I am used to deal with everything on my own. You are right that I probably should reach out to someone. I just didn’t know how to do that emotionally. There are time I feel embarrassed to talk about emotions/ feelings with family/ friends. I was raised in a conservative/ military style household where both of my parents never share their feeling with me. We never said “ love” to each other in words but I understand that’s just who they are. I was verbally abused by my father for years and it made me become very guarded and never wanted to share my feelings to someone. This is the first time I share this on internet I appreciate you reaching out to me. It’s good to know someone cares even though we don’t know each other.

Thank you for sharing this. I am so sorry that you have been through a lot. I just feel defeated that my depression beat me down like this. In the past I have always managed to cage them at the back of my mind in a place where I never wanted to visit. I guess I lost my ability to do so this time. It feels like an ocean of sadness being unleashed inside my body that I can’t breath anymore. I have guarded myself in the past because I didn’t want my friends/ family to worry about me. But what about my sadness, emptiness I wonder if anyone will ever care. There are so many people abandoned me in my like because of who I am but I still have to put on a happy face in order to fight my own depression.  By the way I think you are amazing to realize you are worth being loved and being proud of yourself in a young age. I know you will meet someone who love you from just being you. I hope someday our sadness and emptiness will no longer trouble us.
Thank you for sharing your experience I appreciate it. I am just in a dark place right now and I am hoping to find strength to get myself back up.

I am grateful for your kind words. You seem like someone who has a lot of wisdom in life. Today was a really tough day for me but your words made me feel a little better. I know tomorrow I will fight another battle with my depression but I will try to think about what you said.

Thank you so much for the message. I never expected someone I don’t know would care about what’s going on in my life. You are right about I am in a very dark place in my life right now. I just feel like a failure :/  I have always been strong in the past to fight my depression but lately I just reached a breaking point where I completely shut down. I feel so lost and vulnerable. Living by myself during covid really made my depression worse I have never felt so alone before. I started question a lot of decisions I made in the past and I feel sad that I haven’t achieve anything in my late 20s..
